name: MuleSoft Anypoint Platform
description: MuleSoft Anypoint Platform is Salesforce's unified iPaaS and full-lifecycle API management solution, letting organizations securely design, build, deploy, secure, and manage APIs and integrations at scale in one platform.
best_for: Enterprise platform and integration teams needing to design, secure, and govern APIs across cloud, on-prem, and hybrid environments, with hundreds of prebuilt connectors for applications, databases, and industry protocols.
features: API Manager for managing APIs, users, traffic analysis, and SLA monitoring in one interface
API security policies, client access management, and API-product grouping
Hundreds of prebuilt cloud connectors for enterprise applications and databases
Anypoint Flex Gateway and API Experience Hub for universal API management
Visual API Designer for design-first API development
Anypoint Studio with prebuilt connectors for building integrations
Automated MUnit testing and deployment to cloud, on-prem, or hybrid environments

alternatives.name: Kong
alternatives.description: Provides API gateway and management products for securely connecting, governing, and monetizing APIs and AI tokens across any cloud.
